items.period: Western Zhou (as labeled by the file description)
items.caption: A modern vector rendering labeled Western Zhou bronze-script 國. It illustrates the enclosing boundary element and the interior form; the file page links it to 彔卣, 集成05420.
items.alt: Modern black line rendering of an early 國 form, enclosed by a nearly rectangular outline, with a more complex angular component inside.
items.selection_reason: A directly relevant reusable example of the enclosed 國 form that the database describes as 囗 plus phonetic 或. Its stated source and date tradition make it suitable to illustrate form, with its redraw status explicit.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 / public domain, as stated on the Wikimedia Commons file page.

limitations.text: The linked direct SVG fetch failed in the web tool. The candidate is retained because its accessible Commons description page provides the identity, named source references, script label, and reuse terms; image pixels were not inspected in this research.

The Academia Sinica evolution page was used only as linked evidence because it states All Rights Reserved. The separate Xiaoxuetang CC0 notice applies to query-interface glyph images, but no exact 國 query candidate was obtained.
